articles.title: Drone-assisted arrest made in Durham armed robbery; 2 boys, aged 14, facing charges
articles.summary: Durham Regional Police have arrested two young teens in connection with an armed robbery investigation in Oshawa. articles.title: 78-year-old woman dead after highway crash in Oakville: OPP
articles.summary: A 78-year-old woman is dead after a crash in Oakville Thursday evening, provincial police say.

articles.summary: A clearer picture of the choices Ontarians will face at the ballot box is set to emerge this afternoon as nominations for the fall municipal elections come to a close. articles.title: 1 killed in overnight collision that closed Hwy. 403 westbound in Oakville
articles.summary: A section of Hwy. 403 westbound in Oakville was shut down early Friday morning after a serious two‑vehicle collision that left one person dead and another injured, Ontario Provincial Police (OPP) say. articles.title: Another Toronto street festival is being lost to funding shortfalls
articles.summary: The co-founder of the Yorkville Murals festival says they were denied city grants awarded in previous years. More applications are leading to more competition for funding, according to a City of Toronto spokesperson.

articles.title: Scarborough busway opening Sept. 30: TTC
articles.summary: The Scarborough busway, a dedicated transit corridor being built to replace the area's defunct Line 3 train service, is opening Sept. 30, the TTC says.

articles.title: Recently resigned Liberal MP runs for city council in Scarborough North
articles.summary: Recently resigned Liberal MP Shaun Chen is throwing his hat in for a Toronto city council position.

articles.title: Motorcyclist dead after crash in Scarborough: police
articles.summary: A man has died in hospital after a motorcycle crash in Scarborough Wednesday evening, police said.
